The source feedback highlights that relying solely on automated classifier scores or generic report generators can lead to missed diagnoses when specific structural changes (like rib erosion) and localized opacities are present. The key learning is to prioritize direct visual evidence of bone destruction adjacent to an apical mass over negative or non-specific automated outputs, especially in patients with risk factors like smoking."]
